notes.subject: ספיח
notes.rationale: Tok bilong kaikai i kamap bilong yet — em i stap long Tanakh hia tasol olsem tok bilong gaden (wantaim Stat 25:11).

notes.subject: נזירך
notes.rationale: Sipela skul: 'diwain grape yu no wokim long en' (nazar, yu no kotim) o 'grap yu no kisim pinis long before' — KJV 'undressed vine' vs ylt 'separated thing'.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim possessiv 'em' long 'graun', Hibru i no gat en.

translation: ⟨את⟩ ol kaikai i kamap bilong yet long gaden bilong yu, yu no ken kotim; na ⟨את⟩ ol grap bilong diwain grape yu no wokim long en, yu no ken kisim — em bai i yia bilong Sabat-malolo bilong ⟨em⟩ graun.
